scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof reduces to an exactly enumerated 329-case cyclotomic-norm certificate; a standalone stdlib program replays this certificate, finite-field tuple counts, and selected independent direct projective counts. The general claim is not extrapolated from examples.
scientific_limitations: Only the diagonal Fermat projective family of degree (q-1)/7 over fields with 7 dividing q-1; rational-point counts, not rational lines, twists, or geometric-point classification. Historical-priority uncertainty for equivalent cyclotomic computations.
title: A six-characteristic rational-point law for seventh-index Fermat surfaces
